releaseTag: v0.1.14 core + expanded game assets + merged GPU and computer contracts
provenance: Preserves the bridge-owned v0.1.14 core with complete u64 browser clock results and PR 201's 32-compilation GPU capability using the merged runtime. The bridge core and browser workers pin pvm-host-runtime#45, raising the bounded package asset ceilings to 128 MiB per file and 256 MiB aggregate so complete libre game data sets can run. The separately pinned GPU worker and pvm-computer.js adapter consume merged pvm-host-runtime#33 and #34, including shared filesystem checkpoints, host-supervised workspaces, cancellation-safe package resolution and inherited child terminal dimensions.
